bundle.shortDescription: Game-asset manager for audio, image, and 3D assets.
bundle.longDescription: 3DAM unifies audio, image, and 3D game assets into one local catalog and layers content-based automation on top: metadata extraction, thumbnails, similarity search, auto-tagging, and deduplication. The desktop app is a native webview shell over the embedded web client, served by an in-process server; the same 3dam binary also provides the serve, mcp, and CLI roles.
